name: Incest
overview: Scripture records instances involving close family relationships, such as Abraham marrying his half-sister (Genesis 20:12-13) and the marriage of Nahor to Milcah, his niece (Genesis 11:29; 24:15). The account of Lot and his daughters (Genesis 19:1, 31) further illustrates complex familial situations. These passages reveal the biblical context of near-kin relationships, highlighting the need to understand what Scripture defines and forbids regarding incestuous unions.
